notes: Baseline of already-available authority signals. A metric without an in-repo source that actually measures that metric is the literal UNKNOWN. GSC samples and organic search-result checks are not branded-search, direct/returning, referring-domain or citation series.

branded_search.limitation: No in-repo branded-query time series (Search Console branded filter, or equivalent) is published. data/organic/search-baseline-2026-08-14.json is a focused live SERP sample, not branded-search volume.

direct_returning.limitation: No first-party analytics extract of direct or returning sessions is stored in this repository. Telemetry exists as an operational collector; it is not a published authority series.

qualified_referring_domains.limitation: No reviewed referring-domain list with qualification criteria is checked in. Do not infer domains from GSC query samples.

citation_reuse.limitation: No observed third-party citation or reuse record is stored. Self-citation on CONFENGE pages is not reuse.

related_sources_not_used_as_these_metric.what_it_is: Focused live search-result sample for entity and priority-demand checks
related_sources_not_used_as_these_metric.what_it_is_not: Branded search volume, direct/returning traffic, referring domains, or citation/reuse

related_sources_not_used_as_these_metric.what_it_is: Search Console Performance export used by the open Radar recorte
related_sources_not_used_as_these_metric.what_it_is_not: Branded-search, direct/returning, qualified referring domains, or third-party citation
